cs14_cl300.geometry_note: Part 1. PALACE numbers not fully trusted; independent check.

resonator_mode.Qc_note: NOT RESOLVED. Q_total_hfss (91002) equals the dielectric Qi (~92231) to within noise -> the R=50 ports add no measurable loss to the resonator mode -> its coupling Qc is unresolved (the printed Qc, from 1/Qc=1/Q_total-1/Qi, is a ratio of two near-equal numbers and is meaningless). The ~16.5 GHz feedline mode IS damped (see all_modes), so the ports work; the coupler gap is just under-meshed.
